scenario: A retailer's web app has unpredictable traffic spikes and the team wants to avoid managing servers. Which compute option fits best?

options.text: A fixed fleet of large Compute Engine VMs sized for peak

explanation: Cloud Run scales to zero and handles bursts without capacity planning.

scenario: A company must run a legacy app that needs a specific kernel module and full OS control. Which compute option fits?
explanation: IaaS provides the most control over the operating system.

scenario: A global e-commerce platform needs a relational database with strong consistency across continents. What should be chosen?

options.text: Cloud SQL with cross-region read replicas
options.note: Writes go to one region; replicas lag.
NoSQL, no SQL transactions across rows.

explanation: Spanner provides external consistency and up to 99.999% availability in multi-region setups.

scenario: An IoT platform ingests millions of time-series writes per second and needs single-digit millisecond reads by key. Which database fits?

options.note: In-memory cache without durable storage at this scale.

explanation: Design row keys to avoid hotspots, e.g., by not leading with timestamps.

scenario: Which database best fits a PostgreSQL app needing high transactional performance plus fast analytical queries on the same data?
explanation: AlloyDB includes a columnar engine for analytics.

scenario: A team wants a disaster recovery design with an RTO of minutes and RPO near zero for a Cloud SQL database. What's best?

options.text: Cloud SQL Enterprise Plus with cross-region replica and failover
Nightly exports to Cloud Storage in the same region
Weekly backups copied to a multi-region Cloud Storage bucket
options.note: RPO of up to a week.

explanation: Choose DR patterns based on RTO/RPO: backup/restore, pilot light, warm standby or multi-region active.

scenario: Which load balancer should front a global HTTPS application with backends in several regions?

options.text: Regional external passthrough Network Load Balancer

explanation: Add Cloud CDN and Cloud Armor to the same load balancer.

scenario: A media company wants to cut egress costs and latency for static video segments worldwide. What should be added?

options.text: Cloud CDN (or Media CDN) in front of the origin
More web server VMs in the origin region
A multi-region Cloud Storage bucket without a CDN
options.note: Still served from storage locations, not edge caches.

explanation: Media CDN is designed for large-scale streaming.

scenario: Which storage option suits petabytes of rarely accessed archival data that must be kept for compliance?

options.text: Cloud Storage Archive class with a retention policy
Persistent Disk snapshots stored in a multi-region location

explanation: Bucket Lock makes retention policies immutable.

scenario: A company wants to migrate VMware VMs to Google Cloud quickly without refactoring. What fits?

options.text: Convert all apps to Cloud Run functions

explanation: Migrate to Virtual Machines can also convert VMs to Compute Engine.

scenario: Which tool helps discover on-premises assets, estimate TCO and plan migration waves?
explanation: Migration Center provides rightsizing and cost estimates.

scenario: A team wants to build an enterprise AI agent grounded in company documents with minimal custom code. What should they use?

options.text: Agent Studio and Agent Search on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
A custom LLM trained from scratch on GKE
BigQuery full-text search with scheduled queries
options.note: Search only; no agent or grounding.

explanation: Agent Search (formerly Vertex AI Search) provides retrieval for grounding.

scenario: Which Google Cloud framework provides best practices across operational excellence, security, reliability, cost and performance?
explanation: It also includes sustainability and AI/ML perspectives.

scenario: Which architecture pattern decouples services so a slow consumer doesn't block producers?
explanation: Event-driven designs improve resilience and scalability.

scenario: A workload needs GPUs for training large models with high-speed interconnects. Which offering helps?

options.text: Spot VMs with a single GPU each
options.note: No high-speed interconnect for large training.

options.text: Cloud Run with GPUs for every training step
options.note: Suited to inference, not large distributed training.

explanation: TPUs are Google's custom AI accelerators.

scenario: Which design improves availability for a regional application at the lowest complexity?

options.text: Spread instances across multiple zones with a regional MIG
Place all VMs in one zone
Use a zonal MIG with autoscaling
options.note: Still exposed to a zone outage.

explanation: Regional managed instance groups distribute VMs across zones.

scenario: A company needs its data to stay in Germany. Which design choice is essential?

options.text: Deploy in a German region and enforce location with organization policy
Encrypt data with CMEK and store it in any region

explanation: Sovereign cloud offerings add further controls.

scenario: Which API management platform helps expose backend services securely to partners with quotas and analytics?
explanation: Apigee also supports API monetization and developer portals.

scenario: Which choice reduces cost for a batch analytics workload that can tolerate interruptions?
explanation: Design jobs to restart from checkpoints after preemption.

scenario: A team needs a fully managed Kubernetes environment where Google manages nodes and security hardening. What fits?

options.text: GKE Standard with manual node pools

explanation: Autopilot bills per pod resource requests.

scenario: Which storage service gives high-performance managed file shares for HPC workloads on Google Cloud?
explanation: Filestore and NetApp Volumes serve general NFS/SMB workloads.

scenario: Which approach makes an architecture cost-efficient for variable demand?

options.text: Use autoscaling and pay-per-use managed services
Provision for peak load all year
Use the largest machine types everywhere
Buy committed use discounts for peak capacity

explanation: FinOps practices align spending with business value.

scenario: Several teams need their own projects but a central network team must control subnets and firewall policy. What design fits?

options.text: Shared VPC with a host project and service projects
A separate auto mode VPC per project
VPC peering between every project pair

explanation: Network admins manage the host project; teams deploy in service projects.

scenario: A company needs a dedicated 10 Gbps private connection from its data center to Google Cloud. What should be used?

options.note: Over the internet, lower throughput per tunnel.
Too little bandwidth for this need.
Reaches Google public services, not your VPC.

explanation: Partner Interconnect suits lower bandwidth or locations without colocation.

scenario: Which option privately connects consumers to a managed service in another VPC without peering?
explanation: PSC uses endpoints with internal IP addresses.

scenario: VMs without external IPs need to access Google APIs privately. What's the simplest setting?

options.text: Enable Private Google Access on the subnet
Assign public IPs to every VM
Create a VPN to Google APIs
Route API traffic through Cloud NAT

explanation: Private Service Connect endpoints are another option for Google APIs.

scenario: Which tool should be used to provision infrastructure consistently across environments?

options.text: Manual console clicks documented in a wiki

explanation: Store IaC in version control and deploy through CI/CD.

scenario: Which approach lets developers quickly create standard, approved environments themselves?

options.text: Application Design Center templates or IaC modules
Give everyone Owner on the organization
Email requests to the network team for every change
Share one project for all teams

explanation: Platform engineering provides golden paths for developers.

scenario: A GKE cluster must keep pods from reaching each other unless explicitly allowed. What should be configured?

options.text: Firewall rules on the node pool's VMs
options.note: Coarse; doesn't control pod-to-pod traffic in the cluster.

explanation: GKE Dataplane V2 enforces network policies with eBPF.

scenario: Which storage choice suits a stateful GKE workload needing a regional, replicated block volume?

options.text: Regional Persistent Disk (or Hyperdisk Balanced HA)
A Cloud Storage bucket as a block device

explanation: Regional disks replicate synchronously across two zones.

scenario: Which Compute Engine feature reduces boot disk management for many VMs by using a common image?

options.text: Custom images in an image family
Using community images from unknown publishers
Copying disks with dd per VM

explanation: Image families point to the latest image for consistent deployments.

scenario: Which DNS design allows on-premises systems to resolve names of private Google Cloud resources?

options.text: Public Cloud DNS zones with private IPs
Editing hosts files on every server

explanation: Outbound forwarding zones resolve on-premises names from Google Cloud.

scenario: Which configuration supports high availability for HA VPN to on-premises?

options.text: Two tunnels from an HA VPN gateway with Cloud Router and BGP
Classic VPN with two gateways and static routes
options.note: Lower SLA; deprecated for new HA designs.

explanation: This configuration supports a 99.99% SLA.

scenario: A team wants serverless containers to reach resources in a VPC. What should be configured?

options.text: Direct VPC egress (or a Serverless VPC Access connector)
Private Google Access on the subnet

explanation: Direct VPC egress avoids managing connector instances.

scenario: Which approach supports blue/green deployments for GKE workloads with minimal risk?

options.text: Deploy a new version alongside the old one and shift traffic via the load balancer or Gateway API
Update all pods in place at once
Delete the cluster and recreate it

explanation: Cloud Deploy supports canary and blue/green strategies.

scenario: Which service centrally manages releases to GKE and Cloud Run with promotion between environments?
explanation: Approvals can gate production promotion.

scenario: A company needs to connect many VPCs and on-premises sites with a hub-and-spoke model. What should be used?

options.note: One network, not hub-and-spoke between VPCs.

options.text: HA VPN tunnels between every pair of VPCs

explanation: Network Connectivity Center also supports SD-WAN integrations.

scenario: Which machine family is best for memory-intensive databases like SAP HANA?
explanation: Choose machine families by workload profile.

scenario: A healthcare company must prevent patient data in BigQuery from being copied to projects outside its perimeter. What should it use?

options.text: IAM deny policies on the dataset
options.note: Blocks principals, not data copied by authorized users.

explanation: Combine with IAM and organization policies for defense in depth.

scenario: Applications on AWS must call Google Cloud APIs without long-lived keys. What should be designed?

options.text: Service account keys stored in AWS

explanation: Federation exchanges external credentials for short-lived tokens.

scenario: Employees need secure access to internal web apps without a VPN. Which approach fits zero trust?

options.text: Identity-Aware Proxy with Chrome Enterprise Premium context-aware access
Open the apps to the internet with passwords
A flat network with no checks
IP allowlists on the load balancer

explanation: Access decisions use identity and device context.

scenario: A financial firm must hold encryption keys outside Google Cloud. What option fits?

options.text: Customer-supplied encryption keys for every service
options.note: Limited service support, keys still provided to Google per request.

explanation: Cloud HSM provides FIPS 140-2 Level 3 hardware keys inside Google Cloud.

scenario: Which service discovers and de-identifies sensitive data like national IDs across storage and BigQuery?

options.note: Encrypts storage; data is still readable to users.

explanation: Techniques include masking, tokenization and format-preserving encryption.

scenario: Which control prevents anyone from creating service account keys across the organization?

options.text: An IAM deny policy on each project
options.note: Possible but harder to manage than one org constraint.

explanation: New organizations have this constraint enforced by default.

scenario: Which product protects generative AI apps from prompt injection and sensitive data leaks?

options.note: Finds sensitive data, but not prompt attacks.

explanation: Model Armor screens prompts and responses.

scenario: Which service only allows signed, trusted container images to deploy to GKE or Cloud Run?
explanation: Attestations prove images passed required checks.

scenario: Which design gives administrators time-bound elevated access with approval?
explanation: Just-in-time access reduces standing privileges.

scenario: Which service gives a central view of security posture, threats and vulnerabilities across the organization?
explanation: Premium and Enterprise tiers add threat detection and attack path simulation.

scenario: A company must prove regulatory compliance with controls for a specific region and framework. What helps?

options.note: Constraints, but not full compliance packages.

explanation: Assured Workloads enforces data residency and personnel access controls.

scenario: Which logs record Google personnel's access to customer content?
explanation: Access Approval lets customers approve such access first.

scenario: Which principle should IAM design follow for workloads?

options.text: One service account per workload with least-privilege roles
One shared service account with Editor for everything

explanation: Use IAM Recommender to remove unused permissions.

scenario: Which service protects public web apps against OWASP Top 10 attacks and DDoS at the edge?

options.note: VPC traffic, not web exploits at the edge.

explanation: Adaptive Protection uses ML to detect Layer 7 attacks.

scenario: Which design stores database passwords and API keys securely for apps?

options.text: Cloud KMS keys used as passwords
options.note: KMS manages encryption keys, not app secrets.

explanation: Rotate secrets and pin versions in apps.

scenario: Executives want to cut cloud costs without hurting performance. What's the best first step?

options.text: Review rightsizing and idle resource recommendations
Delete monitoring to save logging costs

explanation: Active Assist recommenders identify idle VMs, disks and IPs.

scenario: A company's VM fleet runs at steady usage 24/7. Which pricing option reduces cost most predictably?

options.text: Spot VMs for the whole fleet

explanation: Flexible (spend-based) commitments apply across machine families.

scenario: Which practice aligns cloud spend with business value through shared responsibility for costs?
explanation: Use labels, budgets and billing exports to show teams their costs.

scenario: A business process requires a human to approve AI-generated insurance claim decisions. What design principle is this?
explanation: High-impact AI decisions benefit from human oversight.

scenario: Which approach helps the team adopt cloud skills and change processes successfully?

options.text: Training, a cloud center of excellence and clear ownership
Centralize every decision with one person to keep control

explanation: Change management is as important as technology.

scenario: Which metric best measures whether a migration improved developer velocity?

options.text: Deployment frequency and lead time for changes (DORA)
Number of VMs migrated per week

explanation: DORA metrics also include change failure rate and time to restore.

scenario: A business needs to analyze customer behavior in near real time to personalize offers. Which architecture fits?

options.text: Pub/Sub to Dataflow to BigQuery with ML models
Nightly batch loads with BigQuery ML

explanation: BigQuery continuous queries can also process streams with SQL.

scenario: Which approach reduces risk when changing a critical business process to run on new cloud systems?

options.text: Pilot with a subset, measure, then roll out gradually
Switch everything at once on a Friday
Avoid informing stakeholders until it's done

explanation: Define rollback plans and success criteria.

scenario: Which analysis helps decide whether to rehost, replatform or refactor each application?
explanation: Consider business value, complexity, dependencies and licensing.

scenario: A company wants to estimate the costs of a new architecture before building it. What should be used?
explanation: Migration Center provides TCO estimates for migrations.

scenario: Which SRE concept balances release velocity with reliability using allowed unreliability?
explanation: When the error budget is spent, focus shifts to reliability work.

scenario: Which licensing consideration matters when migrating Windows Server and SQL Server workloads?

options.text: Licenses never matter in the cloud
Licenses only matter for Linux distributions

explanation: Sole-tenant nodes help with some BYOL requirements.

scenario: A team wants to quickly prototype gen AI features without managing models. What's the best starting point?

options.text: Use Gemini models through Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform APIs
Build a GPU cluster and train a model from scratch
Hire annotators to label data first
Fine-tune an open model on GKE first

explanation: Prototype quickly, then evaluate quality, cost and safety.

scenario: Developers want a consistent, Google-managed cloud development environment with access to private resources. What fits?
explanation: Cloud Workstations runs IDEs in managed containers inside your VPC.

scenario: Which tool helps developers emulate Google Cloud services locally for testing, like Pub/Sub and Firestore?
explanation: Emulators speed up development without cloud costs.

scenario: Which CI service builds containers and runs tests on each commit?
explanation: Cloud Build can push images to Artifact Registry.

scenario: Which API style should a team choose for high-performance service-to-service communication with strict contracts?
explanation: REST remains common for public APIs.

scenario: Which approach safely tests a new version with a small percentage of real users?
explanation: Monitor error rates before increasing traffic.

scenario: Which tool helps developers write and understand code with AI assistance in their IDE?

options.note: Helps with cloud operations, not IDE coding.

explanation: Gemini CLI provides AI assistance in the terminal.

scenario: A migration must move 500 TB from on premises with limited bandwidth. What's best?
explanation: Storage Transfer Service suits online transfers when bandwidth allows.

scenario: Which technique keeps APIs backward compatible when releasing changes?

options.text: Versioning APIs and avoiding breaking changes
Renaming fields to match new conventions

explanation: Apigee and API Gateway help manage versions.

scenario: Which practice makes infrastructure changes reviewable and auditable?

options.text: Pull requests for IaC with automated plan checks
Shared admin passwords stored in a vault

explanation: GitOps applies the same principle to Kubernetes.

scenario: Which service manages database schema and data migrations from Oracle to PostgreSQL-compatible databases?
explanation: Gemini can help convert code during heterogeneous migrations.

scenario: Which testing type verifies the system handles expected peak traffic before launch?
explanation: Chaos testing checks resilience to failures.

scenario: Which metrics define user-facing reliability targets for a service?
explanation: Alert on SLO burn rate rather than every metric.

scenario: Which alerting approach reduces noise while catching real user impact?
explanation: Multi-window burn rate alerts balance speed and precision.

scenario: Which tool helps find which functions use the most CPU in production code?
explanation: Profiler runs continuously with low overhead.

scenario: Which practice improves learning after incidents?
explanation: Track action items to completion.

scenario: Which tool provides a single place to manage alerts, dashboards and uptime checks?
explanation: Google Cloud Observability includes Monitoring, Logging, Trace and Profiler.

scenario: Which design helps GKE workloads survive a zone outage?

options.text: Regional clusters with pods spread across zones

explanation: Pod disruption budgets protect availability during maintenance.

scenario: Which practice validates disaster recovery plans actually work?

options.text: Regular DR drills and restore tests
Writing a plan once and never testing it
Testing only in production during peak

explanation: Measure actual RTO and RPO during drills.

scenario: Which service provides personalized notifications about Google Cloud incidents affecting your projects?

options.note: Check your endpoints, not Google incidents.

explanation: Integrate alerts with your incident management tools.

scenario: Which approach automates responses to common operational issues?

options.text: Runbooks automated with Cloud Run functions or Workflows

explanation: Automation reduces toil, a key SRE goal.

scenario: Which AI assistant helps operators investigate issues and summarize logs in the Google Cloud console?

options.note: Groups errors but doesn't investigate with AI.

explanation: It can help with troubleshooting and optimization recommendations.

scenario: Which technique ensures a service degrades gracefully under overload?
explanation: Circuit breakers and retries with backoff also help.
